concerns.action: canLock(lockEvidence: LockEvidence[], params) — over an EVIDENCE HISTORY (each: window 1|7|21, unseen bool, correct bool, pKnownLB, dimension?, at). In-session attempts are kind retrieval/new_acquisition, NEVER delayed_lock_check, so cannot contribute. Lock requires an unseen correct clear at pKnownLB>=threshold in EACH of the 1/7/21 windows + the transfer dims covered.

Exact: pRecall(elapsed,S)= elapsed<=0?1:clamp(2^(-elapsed/S),0,1). Success: spacing=(1-pRecall); S'=clamp(S*(1+GROWTH*spacing),MIN,MAX) but elapsed<=0 (massed) => S'=S (no durability from cramming). Fail: S'=clamp(S*FAIL_FACTOR,MIN,MAX). Const MIN=0.5,MAX=365,GROWTH,FAIL_FACTOR=0.5. nextReviewAt = lastRetrieval + S*log2(1/targetRecall).

engine-local Evidence{kind:'new_acquisition'|'retrieval'|'delayed_lock_check', correct, elapsedDays, unseen, dimension?} derived from SELECTION/session context — NOT StudentAttempt.source (provenance-only). applyEvidence routes by kind: new_acquisition->BKT only (retention stays prior); retrieval/delayed_lock_check->both layers. Generative: BKT latent=known, retention latent=durable (orthogonal -> same obs, no double-count). Tests: acquisition cannot mutate retention; retrieval mutates both exactly once.
